mapper.insert: insert into member ( userid, userpw, username, nickname, email, gender, toplct_id, detail_address, profile_img, seller_status, provider, enable_flag, agree_terms_required, agree_privacy_required, agree_location_optional, agree_marketing_email, agree_marketing_sms ) values ( #{userid}, #{userpw}, #{username}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{toplct_id}, #{detail_address}, 'default_profile.png', 'N', 'LOCAL', '1', #{agree_terms_required}, #{agree_privacy_required}, #{agree_location_optional}, #{agree_marketing_email}, #{agree_marketing_sms} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.userid, m.userpw, m.username, m.nickname, m.email, m.gender, m.toplct_id, m.detail_address, m.profile_img, m.seller_status, m.provider, m.enable_flag, m.regdate, m.updatedate, m.deleted_at, m.agree_terms_required, m.agree_privacy_required, m.agree_location_optional, m.agree_marketing_email, m.agree_marketing_sms, a.auth FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_auth a ON m.userid = a.userid WHERE m.userid = #{userid}
